description: Aetherial-Skies aims to be a lightweight, modular, physics engine that adds gravity blocks and gravity based entity supports, aiming to be an alternative of the famous but yet buggy mod, ValkyrienSkies.

mods.name: Aetherial Skies
mods.description: This mod aims to do a better job than what Valkyrien Skies does and not have as much bugs as it.!
